name: Graph-Tooling Reconciliation (query-vs-rebuild contract + the mandated graph-call manifest)
description: Reconcile the ~30 comp-* graph tools + the two graphs (repo/code trace graph + live-AWS cloud graph) + the Kuzu Cypher query layer into ONE query-vs-rebuild contract with an authoritative, enforced graph-call manifest. Andrew-directed 2026-06-11. The capability is mature but ACCESS is unreconciled: three cost classes (comp-aws derive ~8min, comp-build ~9.8s, comp-platinum rebuild-every-call vs comp-kuzu/comp-trace ~ms query) with no contract for when to query vs rebuild; two graphs not yet one queryable substrate (Kuzu holds cloud only; trace join = P2-STITCH); no authoritative call catalog (comp-tools.yaml is hints, not a mandated manifest). Headline deliverable = org/modules/graph/graph-call-manifest.yaml cataloging EVERY graph use-case -> its canonical call (query/rebuild, layer, cost, freshness), referenced in CLAUDE.md + MANDATED for any graph-querying code change (gate: comp-manifest-check). Converges with NFRA_GLOBGRPH P2-STITCH (trace->Kuzu cross-layer) + reuses NFRA_COMPAWS WAVE-4 cloud graph + the NFRA_DTAFLP firm-vocab (build_firm_gold_dag/FIRM_BUCKET).
